product_metadata.title: Birthday Candles Extended Big Number Candle Multicolor 3D Design Cake Topper Decoration for Any Celebration(4 Candle Blue)
features: Proper Size - Width:1.9in. Number Height:2.76in.Total height:5.6in. Extended big and thick. Held up great and hardly melted like traditional candles. It was definitely a top candle in terms of aesthetics and functionality.
Environment Friendly - We use quality Eco-friendly, non-toxic materials to make these magical candles that are smokeless, no wax dripping down and can burn for a very long time.
Perfect Packaged - This candle is simply gorgeous and it was packaged well. Not easily damaged in transport and storage like other candles.

Wide Usage - It's not only a prefect addition to birthday cakes, homemade cake or cupcakes but also a good partner for any celebrations, such as weddings, reunions, baby shower, party or business's anniversary.
Warm Note - Please keep birthday cake candles in shade place away from the fire. If you are unhappy with the birthday candles for ANY reasons, we offer new replacement or full refund.
